text:
Ava: Procurement put Ledgerly and ReconFlow on the shortlist for our automated invoice matching POC. Need quick answers on CSV schema, delta imports, SSO, and pricing. Any red flags?

Ben: Ledgerly had a nice mapping UI but their backfill required an agent for >12 months of history. ReconFlow claims cloud-only bulk ingest.

Rina: I tested ReconFlow sandbox yesterday. Bulk endpoint accepts gzipped NDJSON and supports a "source_id" and "external_id" dedupe key. UI backfill capped at 60 days.

Finance-bot: Reminder: include estimated annual run-rate. Anything >$10k/yr needs director approval.

procurement: @vendor-james can you confirm Ledgerly bulk API and sample schema? Also SAML + SCIM support?

vendor-james: Hi team : Ledgerly accepts gzipped CSV via POST /api/imports with mapping fields: account_id, external_id, invoice_date, due_date, currency, total, tax, lines_json. SAML + SCIM supported; SCIM groups on roadmap. Sample: https://docs.ledgerly.example/imports

vendor-james: Quick curl:

 curl -X POST https://api.ledgerly.example/api/imports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -F "file=@invoices.csv.gz" \
  -F "mapping=account_id,external_id,invoice_date,total"

Ava: Good. Any rate limits? We need to handle spikes near close (50k invoices/day).

vendor-james: Default rate limit 1,000 req/min. For heavy backfills we recommend batch uploads or an enterprise agent that streams into our queue.

Rina: Pricing samples? We need per-invoice and base fees to estimate TCO.

vendor-james: Ledgerly Starter: $300/mo + $0.015/invoice. Enterprise: custom, includes BYOK, signed agent, and premium SLAs. One-time onboarding $1,250.

Ben: ReconFlow pricing? Any hidden connector fees?

procurement: @procurement can you confirm ReconFlow details?

procurement: ReconFlow rep sent quote: $0.02/invoice + $400/mo platform fee, first 5 connectors included, additional $150/connector/mo. Onboarding $2k.

Infra: Both vendors: will they require outbound access from our internal nets? Ledgerly agent or ReconFlow cloud?

vendor-james: Ledgerly cloud doesn't require outbound from internal systems for standard flow, but agent option will. Agent uses mutual TLS and posts to ingestion endpoints. Checksums provided.

Rina: ReconFlow sandbox also provided an incremental import endpoint: POST /v1/imports/incremental with dedupe_key param. Performance looked okay in EU region.

Finance-bot: PO rules: experiments under $2k can be manager approved. Keep pilot spend under that if possible.

Legal: For either vendor we need a DPA, 30-day data return, and BYOK option for EU data. Also confirm encryption in transit+rest.

vendor-james: Ledgerly supports customer-managed keys (Enterprise). Encryption in transit and at rest standard. DPA template available.

Ava: Proposed next steps: 7-day side-by-side pilot with a scripted dataset (10k invoices including duplicates and credit memos). Metrics: ingest error rate, dedupe FP rate, p95 lookup latency, integration hours, and first-year TCO. Owners: Ava -> Ledgerly POC, Rina -> ReconFlow POC, Ben -> perf analysis.

procurement: I'll scope SOW to keep one-time fees low. Will request sandbox creds and a sample nested-lines CSV from both vendors.

ReconFlow note (from procurement): Sandbox creds and sample NDJSON link provided by ReconFlow rep via DM.

Ava: Thanks everyone 44d I'll post a short status update in 7 days.

Ben: +1

Rina: Starting ReconFlow ingest tests now.

Infra: We'll open a temporary egress rule for the agent if needed and track security exception.

Legal: I'll prep baseline DPA and add BYOK checklist.

procurement: Closing loop here 4c4 will update vendor scorecard with quotes and pilot plan.
